prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, upper-body portrait, vertical portrait-orientation. One woman centred in the frame, face clearly visible, framed from the very top of her head down to just below the bust, the frame cutting off there. Mid 20s.

A Japanese woman, mid 20s, with an overwhelming glamour hourglass physique with a gigantic towering bust dominating her upper body, a tiny cinched waist and smooth rounded shoulders, and a cherry-blossom shrine-maiden heroine look brought to life, with long glossy black hair in a low ponytail tied with a red and white cord, straight bangs and a few pale pink petals in the strands. Her complexion is a fair porcelain with a soft pink glow, each strand real hair with natural shine, fine flyaways and a few loose wisps. Her eyes are huge, perfectly round eyes with an enormous visible iris in deep rose-pink contact lenses with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, one large bright catchlight and one small catchlight in each iris, a thick drawn lower lash line, long curled lashes, a pale pink shimmer on the lids and a fine soft liner, under thin, high, simple brows, with real wet eyes and real eyelid skin around them, the eyes taking up about half the width of her face in exaggerated anime proportion, with the iris filling most of the eye opening, set slightly wider apart than normal, with a crisp dark double-eyelid line and a faint luminous ring of light in each iris. Her lips are soft and glossy, in a coral-pink gradient, deeper in the centre and fading at the edges, curved into a gentle smile. A deep warm-pink blush spreads in soft round patches over both cheeks and across the tip of the nose. A tiny nose reduced to a small soft rounded dot with a faint shade beneath it, the bridge and nostrils almost invisible, a very small simple mouth with the corners lifted slightly, a small pointed chin, and a narrow, delicately pointed anime face shape. A gentle, pure, wide-eyed gaze with a hint of shyness. She is wearing a cosplay costume: a white silk shrine crop top with a centre front zipper, red and white cord trim and tiny cherry-blossom charms, her shoulders and arms bare. Jewelry: on each ear, five separate heavy ear weights of real blackened cast iron hanging from a polished silver ring through the lobe, each on its own silver chain of a different length so they hang staggered at different heights and fully visible side by side: on the left ear a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim, a pyramid-shaped lump, a teardrop-shaped sinker, a ship's anchor, a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre; on the right ear a cube-shaped block, a round bell, a miniature anvil, a hammer head, a square-sided cowbell. Every weight is a dense, solid, rough, matte, hammered lump of black cast iron about the size of a large walnut, hanging freely in the air with the longest weight ending at the level of her collarbones, and their weight gently pulls each earlobe down into a soft, slightly elongated, healthy loop of smooth skin. At her neck she wears a real chunky sterling silver cable-chain necklace resting on her collarbones. Pose: head tilted slightly, one hand lightly catching a falling petal beside her cheek.

Background: a softly blurred shrine path lined with cherry blossoms and warm lantern bokeh.

Her skin, across her face, neck, shoulders, chest and arms, is real human skin with visible fine pores across the nose and cheeks, a few tiny freckles and small beauty marks on her face, shoulders, chest and arms, a faint uneven warmth with a pink flush on the cheeks and the tip of the nose, a soft shadow under the eyes, fine natural lines at the corners of the eyes and lips, a light natural sheen on the nose, forehead, collarbones and chest, and the rest of her skin in a soft natural matte finish, real living flesh with warmth. She is a professional cosplayer in a flawless cosplay transformation: large circle lenses, thick false lashes with drawn lower lashes, eyelid tape for a wide double lid, contouring that shrinks the nose and sharpens the chin, and a high-quality wig with a natural hairline and real-looking strands.
Lighting: bright, soft, even light across her face with only gentle shading. Shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. 8K vertical portrait-orientation 3:4 aspect ratio.
